Single authored HTML admission gate rollout: shadow records same-input parity; enforce requires digest-bound admission receipts.
Strip a whitelist of harmless authored-HTML admission findings (break/page-break CSS declarations, a hidden attribute on bound or unbound elements) before the renderer admission gate.
Authored HTML normalization representation: legacy keeps source-span rewrites; tree uses pinned HTML5 parsing and canonical serialization.
Render CSS-only density/emphasis candidates for authored figure slides and keep the best measured one.
Candidates rendered per figure slide, including the baseline (1-4).
Per-attempt deadline for one image provider call, in seconds. A picture that exceeds it degrades to the HTML-only figure instead of holding the deck's deadline.
Run the closed-operation design critic on DOM-flagged and figure slides only.
Give a slide that is still terminal after the bounded repair one automatic lower-density remake, then publish the deck with that slide flagged instead of failing the whole deck.
Publish a verbatim source-reflow deck with geometry-defective slides flagged after strict whole-deck source readback passes, without re-authoring those slides.

Run the deterministic local fit on verbatim source-reflow decks as well. Off by default: the fitter may shrink type within its 9pt floor and 10% cap, which is a product decision for verbatim source text.
Keep each slide's pre-repair author_html and illustrated_html in authored_slide_checkpoints after the deck is published, for offline fit measurement; the default clears them to save storage.
Run the deck-wide infographic plan and draw planned figures from the archetype component library; off authors every slide by free composition.
Bind ordinary authored decks to the server-frozen composition envelope (text/qid budgets, 15px floor); off leaves composition to the model as before 2026-08-28.
Freeze a story kind and silhouette per slide and brief the author with it; off leaves composition to the model as before 2026-08-22.
Route source_content_restyle to the server-owned Composer (typed plan, fit ladder, zero provider calls) instead of the authored rewrite.
Raster fallback elements a hybrid-exported slide may keep before it is marked a quality failure.

Authored provider rate profile: auto derives token for codex and api for every other provider; token keeps the conservative three-slide batches, api authors one slide per call at the author concurrency.
Ceiling for the authored author concurrency under the api rate profile (the token profile keeps 8).
Explicit authored author concurrency; unset takes the rate profile default (token 5, api 5) and is clamped to the profile ceiling.
Explicit slides per authoring provider call; unset takes the rate profile default (token 1, api 1).
Explicit steady-state authoring calls per scheduling wave; unset takes the rate profile default (token 2, api the author concurrency).
Consecutive successful authoring calls after an overload cooldown before one concurrency step is restored; unset takes the rate profile default (3).
Seconds of public generation deadline budgeted per slide inside one authoring call; unset takes the measured default (80).
Fixed seconds of public generation deadline budgeted per authoring wave on top of the per-slide allowance; unset takes the measured default (60).
Residual seconds of public generation deadline for deck plan, illustration, images and persistence; unset takes the measured default (600).
Seconds of public generation deadline budgeted for the outline stage inside the preamble term; unset takes the measured default (420).
Seconds of public generation deadline budgeted for the header contract inside the preamble term; unset takes the measured default (90).
Seconds of public generation deadline budgeted for one repair/remake wave; unset takes the measured default (280).
Seconds of public generation deadline budgeted for the chromium review of one slide; unset takes the measured default (8).
Seconds of public generation deadline budgeted for re-rendering one remade slide during review; unset takes the measured default (110).
Ceiling on the authoring wave concurrency the deadline formula may assume, so a wider configured wave cannot shrink a budget; unset takes the measured default (2).
Stuck-job ceiling on the whole public generation deadline; unset takes the default (14400), set above the formula for the largest admitted deck.
Fraction of the remaining public operation deadline the content brief stage may spend; unset takes the default (0.25).
Base deadline in seconds for one content brief attempt before the per-kchar term; unset takes the measured default (600).
Seconds added to a content brief attempt's deadline per 1,000 input characters; unset takes the default (1).
Cap in seconds on one content brief attempt's scaled deadline; unset takes the default (900), never below the base.

Ceiling in seconds on the content brief stage as a whole (first attempt plus its one retry); unset takes the default (1500 = max + base), never below the max. It is also the brief term of the public generation deadline.

Minimum deadline in seconds a content brief retry must be able to get before it is attempted; below it the stage falls back to the raw source at once. Unset derives it from the base (0.8 x base = 480).

Require the durable, PostgreSQL-backed cross-process provider admission path instead of best-effort in-process admission; multi-process deployments (API and worker processes sharing PostgreSQL) must set this to true.

How start.js provides the external workspace operation worker when WORKSPACE_OPERATION_WORKER_MODE=external: bundled spawns one generation worker beside the API in the same container (stock images); service means a separate deployment unit runs python -m services.workspace_operation_worker (the docker-compose multi profile), so start.js must not spawn one.

Deployment tier (local, development, staging, production) used to gate managed-only behavior such as mandatory durable provider admission and stricter transport security; set per service in docker-compose.yml, not through the shared compose environment block.
Enable Mem0 presentation memory (context capture and retrieval) during generation and slide editing.
Per-call timeout in seconds for a Mem0 memory add/search call; a call exceeding this is treated as a failed, non-fatal call.
Concurrent image provider calls per process (1-8). Replaces the single process-wide lock; ENABLE_PARALLEL_IMAGE_GENERATION=true still means unbounded.
Embed fonts by default in hybrid PPTX exports of CJK-language decks when the caller did not say. Without embedding every Hangul run is exported as a picture.
Author the first content slide alone and hand its stylesheet to every other slide as the deck's established visual language.
Generate the optional knowledge brief before an authored outline. False skips its provider call and grounds the outline directly in the supplied source and document context.
Share of content slides (0-1) that receive one generated illustration slot, decided deterministically per deck. 0 disables illustrations and drops the slot rules from the prompt.
Show the style's checked-in exemplar slide (authored_styles/exemplars/<style>.html) to the author as visual-language reference. No-op for styles without one.
After generation, send one deck contact sheet to the vision-capable model and record its advisory findings in the receipt. Never a gate.
Median usable characters per outline slide below which a document-backed request gets one bounded expansion call. 0 disables.
Repair header-contract geometry and part violations deterministically before spending a re-authoring call.
Try the bounded deterministic text-scale rung on overflow/clipping defects before the first remake.
Record deck-level quality instruments (empty band, palette conformance, radius families, margin drift, small computed fonts, stretched images) in the receipt. Never a gate.
Browser-metrics LRU entries kept per process so a long deck's tail does not re-render slides for telemetry.
Browser-metrics LRU byte budget in megabytes.
Admit the next authoring call as soon as one finishes (semaphore) instead of waiting for the whole wave.

Optional reasoning effort for the OpenAI provider's chat-completions API on reasoning-capable models (o1/o3/o4/gpt-5/gpt-6 families). Unset sends no reasoning parameter; other model families reject it.

Optional lighter model id for latency-sensitive structured tasks (header contract, content brief, chapter plan, outline expansion, vision advisory) via utils.llm_provider.get_model_for. No call site adopts this yet; unset keeps every task on the main configured model.
Share one fenced transaction across the checkpoint writes of a slide stage instead of committing each one separately. The fencing CAS still runs as the first statement of every transaction.
Store NULL for a slide checkpoint's illustrated_html when it is byte-identical to author_html. Readers must go through services.authored_checkpoint_html; keep this false until every reader does.
Write local stage-timing receipts from a bounded in-process queue in batches instead of one transaction per stage. Overflow drops receipts rather than blocking generation.
Ceiling in seconds for the exponential idle backoff of the worker-lane poll loops (operation runner, outbox dispatcher, authored progress poller). Cancellation latency is unaffected.

Batch same-deck authored renders behind one per-deck renderer worker lease when this process requires the external isolated renderer worker boundary. Off falls back to one isolated-worker call per render.
Idle seconds of inactivity before a per-deck renderer worker lease self-closes.
Renders a per-deck renderer worker lease serves before it force-closes; the next render for that deck opens a fresh lease.
Render one throwaway blank slide during startup on processes that run generation so the first authored render of a real deck does not pay the renderer's cold start.

Talk to the isolated renderer worker over the length-prefixed framed protocol so one worker process and one Chromium serve many renders of a deck. Requires a launcher and worker image that speak frames; off keeps one worker process per render.

Framed renderer worker processes one per-deck lease may keep open, clamped to 1-4. Higher values render more slides of the same deck concurrently at the cost of one Chromium each; only used when AUTHORED_RENDERER_FRAMED_PROTOCOL_ENABLED is on.
Start each slide's illustrate/render/quality/checkpoint tail as soon as that slide's own authoring lands, instead of waiting for the whole deck to be authored first. Off restores the phase barrier.
Consume the authoring call as a stream and stop reading a runaway or already-finished response early, counting the abort as one invalid-HTML attempt.
Send a per-deck prompt_cache_key with each authoring call so the provider can reuse the deck-invariant prompt prefix across slides.
Carry the deck-invariant design-system block in the authoring call's system message instead of repeating it inside each slide's user message. The assembled prompt text is unchanged.

Comma-separated hostnames (exact or *.suffix wildcard), IP addresses, or CIDR ranges exempted from the webhook outbound URL guard's private/loopback/link-local rejection. Empty by default: no internal webhook target is admitted until the operator explicitly lists it here.

Ship the 2026-09-05 composition-shaping prompt bundle: the COMPOSITION INTENT block and the type ramp. Off because a blind paired rating of 24 slides preferred the pre-bundle parent 13 to 7 with 4 ties, and the bundle's 18px body floor plus its fill-the-page direction overflowed the card and footer band on 17 of 24 bench slides. With it off a deck reads the parent's pre-bundle type-scale wording and no intent block; the bundle's mechanical half (semantic-role vocabulary, SVG contract, shared universals, deck tokens) ships either way.
Author source-reflow verbatim slides with whole-block or grapheme-safe exact-cover character-range tokens; substitute trusted source text in the admission gate. Off preserves legacy text binding.
